environment.description: Same Quarkus Lambda deployed via AWS SAM in us-east-1. Lambda runs in an isolated VPC. The API Gateway endpoint is configured as a PRIVATE REST API with a VPC Endpoint policy (vpce-0abc123def456) that restricts invoke access to principals within the account's VPC. The Lambda function's VPC subnets have NO NAT Gateway and NO internet gateway attached — route tables contain only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.0.0/16) and routes to the com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api VPC interface endpoint. DNS resolution within the VPC is handled by Route 53 Resolver with an outbound endpoint forwarding only to an on-premises DNS server (10.0.200.53) that serves authoritative zones for internal domains and returns NXDOMAIN for all external queries. The Lambda security group (sg-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a) has outbound rules limited to TCP 443 to prefix list pl-63a5400a (S3 gateway endpoint) and TCP 443 to the CIDR of the execute-api VPC endpoint ENIs only.

config.api_gateway: PRIVATE REST API (resource policy: aws:SourceVpce = vpce-0abc123def456)

dns_resolution.route53_resolver_outbound: 10.0.200.53 (on-prem, internal zones only, NXDOMAIN for external)
